The graphic in @fig-overdose-deaths appeared in an editorial in the *New York Times*. The editorial states this fact: "More than 400,000 Americans died from drug overdoses between 2020 and 2023."

Assume that the graphic shows a continuous function of the date.

a. Would the graphic, as labeled, be consistent with the statement? 

b. What are the units for the vertical axis if the graphic is to be consistent with the statement and show a continuous function of the date?
